remarks: Start your summer at the picturesque and peaceful Winnipauk Village-offering more amenities than most communities! Residents enjoy two sparkling pools, Newer tennis and pickleball courts, beautifully landscaped grounds perfect for walking or jogging, a fitness center with a racquetball court, and a clubhouse ideal for gatherings and events. This freshly painted, two-bedroom townhouse-style condominium features laminate flooring in the entryway and the LR, tiles at kitchen and half bath, wall to wall carpet at the BR and stares and hall way at second floor. The spacious living room includes a dedicated dining area and sliding doors that open to a large private deck for entertainment and relax at all time. Additional highlights include central air, an in-unit laundry closet conveniently located on the upper level, a reserved parking space, and plenty of visitor parking nearby. Winnipauk Village is ideally situated in a prime Norwalk location-just a short drive to Calf Pasture Beach, Cranbury Park, historic So No, Public Golf Course, schools, shopping, Metro-North train stations, major highways and more. Approximately 51 miles to Midtown Manhattan. Don't miss this opportunity to enjoy resort-style living all summer long!
